scripts.test: bash scripts/run-local-supabase.sh start >/dev/null && supabase test db && bash scripts/run-backend-database-tests.sh && bash scripts/check-python-db-types.sh && (cd apps/backend && uv run pytest -m 'not database') && (cd apps/collector && uv run pytest) && pnpm test:metadata && pnpm test:setup && pnpm test:prompts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @slowpoke/web typecheck && (cd apps/backend && uv run pyright)
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps/web/src apps/web/scripts scripts apps/web/next.config.ts apps/web/postcss.config.mjs && (cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check .)
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix apps/web/src apps/web/scripts scripts apps/web/next.config.ts apps/web/postcss.config.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt && (cd apps/backend && uv run ruff format .)
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check && (cd apps/backend && uv run ruff format --check .)
scripts.db:reset: bash scripts/run-local-supabase.sh start >/dev/null && bash scripts/run-local-supabase.sh db reset --local
